nodes.name: mcp__evimed__geo_read
nodes.description: 循证 GEO pages: counts and unknowns. Filters: inclusive dates (Asia/Shanghai), engines, questionVersion, groups, pools. Reuse selectionRef and members.metric for exact snapshots. Comparisons are observational. analysis gives exact tables/members. planContextRef pages frozen input. signal reads bound inputs; targetKey pages 4000-character material parts. Actions give lean rows; filter.key or groupId reads one whole. version reads old value.

nodes.name: mcp__evimed__geo_visibility_probe
nodes.description: Ask the consumer LLM front-ends (DeepSeek, Doubao, Kimi, Qianwen, Yuanbao) a question the way a patient would, and record what they answer. This is a measurement with a denominator, not a retrieval: a vendor that failed to answer is not a vendor that did not mention the product, and a vendor that is not logged in was never asked. Use op=providers before a batch, op=ask per question, op=screenshot to retrieve the evidence image by name.

nodes.name: mcp__evimed__geo_write
nodes.description: Write this 循证 GEO project. questions: groups merge into the map by name+pool (data.replace:true = whole map); rows+requestKey save original rows under a measurement contract. start_diagnosis measures a saved version; recover_diagnosis retries failed cells under a new requestKey (reuse one only to retry that call); acknowledgeUnknown only if the user accepts a possible billed duplicate. value merges by id; research runs after this run.

data.description: Imported questions: rows[{text,originalId?,originalGroup?,clientTags?,kind?,sourceUrl?,collectedAt?,pool?,journeyStage?,audience?,isMeasured?,classificationStatus?}], contract{samplingMode:one_shot|recurring,engines,repeats(one_shot=1),metricIds,reportPresentation:summary|detailed,sourceBasis:answers|answers_and_project_sources},requestKey. Preserve original text; kind defaults client; real requires URL and date; classificationStatus is unclassified|suggested|confirmed. start_diagnosis:{version,requestKey}; recover_diagnosis:{roundId,requestKey,jobIds,acknowledgeUnknown?} for failed calls. Read diagnosis_progress with filter.round before recovery. Never default acknowledgeUnknown to true; keep a requestKey only when retrying the same call.

nodes.name: mcp__evimed__literature_search
nodes.description: Search the biomedical and scientific literature (PubMed and the other configured sources) through the EviMed evidence adapter. By default the answer leads with PubMed's Best Match records and adds the EviMed index's records that PubMed did not return (up to `limit` from each; an index record is compact — abstract cut to 800 characters, no AI summary); `databases` ["pubmed"] asks PubMed alone and ["internal"] asks the EviMed index alone with its full abstracts and AI summaries. Supply `relation` instead to retrieve the literature PubTator3 records a relation in — papers that assert the relation, not papers where both terms merely co-occur; get the concept identifiers from term_normalize. Supply `pmids` instead to fetch the abstracts, publication types and MeSH headings of PubMed records you have screened in (up to 200); each abstract is preserved and quotable. Public results are bibliographic metadata unless abstract or full-text fields are explicitly present; never infer study design, evidence level, outcomes, or effect estimates from a title.

offset.description: PubMed route: results to skip. data.outcome says when more exist and what to pass.

articleTypes.description: EviMed's own study-type labels, e.g. 随机对照试验 for randomized controlled trials.

databases.description: Default (omit it): PubMed first, then the EviMed index's extra records, compact. ["pubmed"]: PubMed only. ["internal"]: the EviMed index only, full abstracts and AI summaries. ["crossref"]: Crossref.

outputSchema.note: MCP publishes no output schema for this tool; these are the result fields an edge may depend on.

nodes.name: mcp__evimed__locate_quote
nodes.description: Find a quotation in a source this run preserved, judged exactly as the delivery gate judges a claim's supportQuote (case, quotation marks, dashes, whitespace, full-width forms, CJK spacing, PDF line breaks, inline citation markers and marked … elisions are forgiven; anything else is not). found=true only for a match the gate accepts; each match has character offsets into the preserved file, its line and context. When not found, match=near passages show what the source actually says, to quote instead. Read-only.

sourceId.description: The .evimed-sources/... path a preserving tool returned, or the id it reported (PMCID, DOI, web-page:<hash>, EVIMED-GUIDE:<id>, label:<approval number>#<section>).

nodes.name: mcp__evimed__web_read
nodes.description: Read one public web page or online document (HTML, PDF, office file) through the platform gateway and preserve it in the workspace as a snapshot with a sha256 receipt. The page itself can be the primary source: an official site, documentation, a release note, a policy text. A long page returns its opening and an outline of the saved file (read sections of it by line range); page=N pages through the text. Pages from regulators, guideline bodies and trial registries are marked official.

page.description: Default 1. A long page's page 1 is its opening and an outline; page N returns the N-th 12,000-character slice of the text.

outputSchema.note: MCP publishes no output schema for this tool; these are the result fields an edge may depend on.

nodes.name: mcp__evimed__web_search
nodes.description: Search the open web through the platform's search gateway. Use it for current information and anything public: official sites, documentation and release pages, policy and regulatory notices, companies and markets, news, and what bibliographic indexes do not carry. Results are search hits, not the pages themselves: read one with web_read before relying on it, and give the reader the page's own address. A hit may carry its date, its site and authority (0-4, the engine's rating of the site).
